_doctrine: Every threshold, clock, state marker, and named role this agent enforces lives here. No skill and no bootstrap file hardcodes a company value. Each entry carries the questionnaire id it came from in its `q` field; keep it. An entry whose `value` is still a placeholder is UNANSWERED, its dependent check is DISABLED, and it appears in `unanswered`. A Group A entry with `confirmed: false` is a legal value that has not been through counsel: the agent flags on it, never acts on it.
_questionnaire: Bookkeeping Agent Setup Questionnaire (46 questions, Groups A-D) plus the shared 4-field configuration cover sheet
shadow_mode_exit_rule: Two consecutive weeks of calibration digests matching reality, ended explicitly by the property manager. Source: questionnaire, What Happens Next.

partial_payment_voids_notice.working_rule_until_answered: Every payment on a noticed account is flagged to the property manager before it is applied.

deposit_clock_trigger.note: move-out, termination of tenancy, and key return are different days

nsf_fee_cap.note: confirm whether it applies to ACH returns as well as checks

owner_disbursement_statutory_deadline.note: many states set none, in which case the management agreement governs

state_1099_filing_required.note: re-confirm with the CPA annually; state rules change

license_required_trades.note: trades requiring a licensed contractor at any amount

jurisdiction_statute_map.note: per-county in some states; deadline clocks are per-property when the portfolio spans jurisdictions

reserve_floor_owner_overrides.note: the management agreement governs; list every per-owner override

reconciliation_variance_threshold.note: splits a small reconciliation difference from a large one

chargeback_gates._note: Deliberately NOT under thresholds{}. B13 gates deposit-deduction authority; B1 gates repair-spend authority. Adjacency confusion between the two is a known failure mode.

payment_application_order.common_baseline: fees, then past-due rent, then current rent
payment_application_order.note: VERIFY against the platform's actual configuration; do not record the assumption

vendor_payment_run_dates.note: fixed run dates are what make invoice-aging alerts meaningful

owner_statement_release_day.hard_rule: statements never release while the trust account is unreconciled

waiver_and_writeoff_authority.note: default; no waiver or write-off on a verbal

retention._note: Where a range is offered, default to the long end until counsel and the CPA set the final numbers.

human_bookkeeper.note: the daily digest recipient — whoever actually posts and pays

backup_decision_maker.note: no answer here is a company structure problem, not a config gap

second_person_verifier.constraint: must not be the person who processed the vendor banking change

account_inventory.hard_rule: NEVER store account or routing numbers here or in any tracked file

suspense_account.phase_zero_if: false — there is nowhere legitimate to park an unidentified payment

read_only_access_paths.note: the agent is read-only by construction; a statement drop into a shared folder is a valid day-one answer

after_hours_escalation_channel.note: suspected fraud needs a channel that works outside business hours

tracker_1099_exists.phase_zero_if: false — building one is a task ahead of year-end

federal_constants._note: Not questionnaire values. Federal rules, recorded here so no skill hardcodes them and so a change has one place to land.

cross_seat._note: Values this seat reads but does not own. A pointer resolves against the owner seat's config when that seat is installed; when the owner seat is absent the value is held locally and marked held_pending_seat.

cross_seat_checks.rule: Must match. Surface a mismatch to the contradiction report; never auto-unify and never pick a winner.

cross_seat_checks.pair: accounting:B1 vendor-bill approval threshold vs maintenance:approval threshold
cross_seat_checks.rule: Related but distinct authorities — repair-spend vs bill-payment. Surface a divergence for eyeball; do not collapse.
